title: The question layout — boxes back on the explanations, nothing sliced

steps.path: Two of your mascot questions, before and after this round
steps.headline: The three explanations are boxes again, sitting side by side above the choices.
steps.changed: Last round I flattened Today / The problem / Proposal to bare text so they would not be mistaken for something you can pick. You said they should stay contained boxes. They are boxes again, sharing one row and one height, on the quieter fill with no hover — what marks a choice now is its Option A heading and a card that lifts under the pointer, not the absence of a box on everything else.
steps.notice: The top of a question reads as three panels of background you can skim across, and the things you can actually choose are plainly below them.
steps.risk: Below about a thousand pixels of room the three stack again rather than becoming unreadable strips.

steps.path: The option cards, on a test deck
steps.headline: Option B is no longer sliced off where the answer buttons begin.
steps.changed: In the narrow column beside a picture, the last option ran 120 pixels past the visible area and stopped dead exactly where Other begins, with nothing to say the rest was below. It now fades into the answer row while there is more to scroll, and the fade clears once you reach the end.
steps.notice: A cut card reads as 'keep scrolling' instead of as a card that ends mid-sentence.
steps.risk: This is a test deck, so the words are placeholders. Judge the layout, not the content.

_comment: A RECORD, not a deck to rebuild. Its pictures came from scratch folders under /tmp that are gone; the answers beside it are what it decided. Re-serve with `serve --no-build` only if the run folders still exist.
